title: Gold authority
description: One immutable corpus citation a case's answer must rest on. PRD §43.2 fixes the member names exactly: {document_id, version_id, node_id, citation_role, required}. PRD §15.3 requires citations to target DocumentVersion + NodeVersion + exact offsets, so quote_start/quote_end are the optional pinpoints.
$comment: VOCABULARY. Authored strictly inside the subset `contracts.jsonschema_min` (CRPS-01) implements — no minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, format, propertyNames or patternProperties, because that engine raises UnsupportedKeywordError on an unknown keyword and a schema it cannot fully enforce must never be reported as satisfied. Constraints those keywords would express live in pipelines/evaluation/src/dataset/checks/**, each with its own finding id and its own negative fixture. IDENTITY. Prefixes are CRPS-01's, as the corpus is actually built: legal_document.id is doc_<uuidv7>, document_version.id is dv_<uuidv7>, node_version.id is nv_<uuidv7>. node_id is the NodeVersion id (nv_) and not the DocumentNode id (node_), because PRD §15.3 pins citations to a NodeVersion. CITATION ROLE. Deliberately no enum literal: packages/contracts publishes the canonical CitationRole family (PRD §15.5) and PRD §45.2 forbids a second copy, so GOLD_SHAPE enforces membership from that export at check time.

document_id.description: legal_document.id in the pinned evaluation CorpusRelease (CRPS-01 identity).

version_id.description: document_version.id — the immutable version the answer is true of.

node_id.description: node_version.id — PRD §15.3's NodeVersion target, not the DocumentNode id.

citation_role.description: A member of the canonical CitationRole family (PRD §15.5), enforced by GOLD_SHAPE from the packages/contracts export. Never restated here.

required.description: true when a correct answer must cite this authority; PRD §43.3 Recall@10 is computed over the required gold nodes.

quote_start.description: Optional pinpoint: inclusive character offset into node_version.canonical_text (PRD §15.3 'exact offsets').

quote_end.description: Optional pinpoint: exclusive character offset. GOLD_SHAPE requires quote_end > quote_start when both are present.
